name: aw-app-uc-phd-ui
description: Frontend for aw-app-uc-phd. A plain Vite+React SPA built to ui/dist/ and served by the app's own FastAPI sub-app — NOT a component-mode plugin bundle. This app is distributed privately, so it is not `signed` and every high-risk capability (ui:code included) would be silently refused; see docs/app-migration-plan.md §2.
